lines.en: I slide along the ground like an ebbing tide.
A wet trail follows me.
I do not step; I merely pass.
There is no shadow beneath my robes.

lines.zh: 周围的水都往我这边靠
lines.en: The water everywhere leans toward me.
The sea smell grows dizzyingly thick.
Everywhere I pass turns wet.
I drift, an inch above the ground.
The surf follows me, growing nearer.
I move along the coastline.
I stand, and the sea falls silent.
The heart of corruption beats in my chest.
I watch the water for a long time.
Mist circles around me.
Someone is praying far away.
There is no rise and fall in my chest.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，水珠停在半空
lines.en: I lift a hand; droplets hang in the air.
This shore is already mine.
I hear the bell in the town.
My hem floats on the water.
Water seeps from the stone beneath me.
A solemn silence.
I tilt my head as if listening.
Every living thing keeps three steps off.
I am patient; I have a whole sea.
The far clouds sink lower.
I lift my eyes, lashes dripping.
You actually dare to look at me.
You do not belong here.

lines.zh: 我轻轻开口，声音在水下
lines.en: I speak softly, my voice underwater.
I have your name now.
I raise a hand; droplets fall from my sleeve.
You need not kneel.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，都会变成岸
lines.en: Where I walk becomes shore.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，水纹就散了
lines.en: I smile, and the ripples break.
Only two steps between us.
I hear your heartbeat clearly.

lines.zh: 你退开的那几步，算聪明
lines.en: Those steps you took back were wise.
My mist scatters; I sway.
I know this kind of pain.
I press my chest; it is hollow.
I take a step; the water falls back three.
My shape is coming apart a little.
I look up, water in my eyes.
The sea flinches for me.
I do not cry out; I call the tide.
You are stronger than I thought.
This shell is cracking.
Mortal food means nothing.
Bring salt water and I will look.
You hold it up so high.
That smell is raw and bloody.
I do not eat; I only watch.
I take it, and I do not return it.
The water will soak it to rot.
Your palm is sweating.
I drop it into the sea.
Such a small offering.
Water pads between us; you cannot touch.
I give half a step; water sounds.
You touched my hem.

lines.zh: 那一下让你手上结了盐
lines.en: That left salt on your hands.
I need not yield; the water yields.
Wet, cold resistance stops you.
The ground is slick; you cannot stand.
You splashed water up.
A tide lies between us.
I look down at you from close by.
The seaborn have no need of such things.
I have time, not a heart.
Propagation is possible; love is not.
I look only at lineage.
You are too easily broken.
The tide will choose for me.

lines.zh: 我的手碰了碰你的脸，很凉
lines.en: My hand touches your cheek, very cold.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是用来爱的
lines.en: This body is not made for love.

lines.zh: 你要留下来，就要变成我
lines.en: To stay, you would have to become me.
I turn; bubbles rise in the water.
The water brings it up for me.
This object is mildly interesting.
I hold it and watch water seep out.
It is too dry; I dislike it.
I sink it into the water.
Whose thing is this?
I keep it as a sort of memory.
One finger raised, and it floats.
The right weight for the bottom.
Take it; it is no use to me.

lines.zh: 整片海岸，都是我的猎场
lines.en: The whole shore is my hunting ground.
You cannot outrun the tide.
I look at you as at an empty shell.

lines.zh: 四方的水都会替我追你
lines.en: Water on every side will chase you.
I am patient; I wait for high tide.
The sea will carry your blood away.
I am beginning to change.
Do not raise that weapon at me.
There is no dry land here.
You are fixed; there is no escape.
I can hear your bones.
Your name is on the water.
The tide begins to turn my way.
I have seen so many like you.
I raise a hand, and the sea rises.
Do not be afraid. It will be quick.
You stand bravely.

lines.zh: 我把所有的水都叫来了
lines.en: I have called all the water here.
The ripples keep pointing at you.
You are in the shallows; you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 你的每一步都踩在我的水里
lines.en: Every step you take lands in my water.

lines.zh: 潮水每涨一寸，我近一步
lines.en: Each inch the tide rises, I draw nearer.
Your breath is going cold.
I need no eyes to see you.
The weight of water presses you.

lines.zh: 你退到的每一处，早就湿了
lines.en: Everywhere you retreat is already wet.
I do not chase; I surround.
I raise my arms slowly.
The shoreline shifts beneath me.
Do you hear the sea sounding?

lines.zh: 你的倒影已经不属于你
lines.en: Your reflection no longer belongs to you.

lines.zh: 我等你力气用光的那口气
lines.en: I wait for the breath where your strength runs out.
This ring of water is very round.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就涨一寸
lines.en: Each step you retreat, I rise an inch.
There is no dry place left.
The sea is flat as a mirror.

lines.zh: 我听见你在水下的声音
lines.en: I hear your voice beneath the water.
The last stretch now.
My fingertips trace your shoulder.
The water presses in with me.
That felt like being struck by a wave.
I lift a hand; the water turns blade.
Your armor grows heavy in the water.
When I draw near, the air turns salt.
Striking you costs me nothing.
That blow carried a cold current.
I press my hand to your chest.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在我掌下停了
lines.en: Your breath stops under my palm.
I step back and watch you kneel.
The sea strikes for me.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指，按在你额上
lines.en: One finger, pressed to your brow.
Salt begins to crust on you.
The tide draws back an inch; I rise.
The water swells first.
The whole shore has gone quiet.
I rise out of the water.
When I open my eyes, the sea darkens.
Someone screams far off.
The water here knows me.
I shake the droplets from my robe.

lines.zh: 脚下的石板裂开，渗出海水
lines.en: The stone splits; seawater seeps out.
My first breath is the sound of surf.
Fish swim in my shadow.
The sky has come lower.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到每一处水洼
lines.en: I feel every puddle.
Every seabird flies inland.
This body is not yet steady.

lines.zh: 我把手按在胸口的枯心
lines.en: I press a hand to the withered heart.
The water begins to circle me.
I hear the deep calling me.
Salt crystals rise along the shore.
I am here.
Fire makes the water hiss.
My hem scatters as I land.
I am the sea; I cannot drown myself.
The blast pushes the water out in a ring.
The arrow enters water and slows.

lines.zh: 咒力在水里烧着我的骨
lines.en: The spell burns my bones through the water.
Hunger is a thing of the living.

lines.zh: 雷在水面上跳到我身上
lines.en: Lightning skips the surface onto me.
No water here, and neither am I.
